method: Hand review of design/parity/evidence/<row>/comparison.png (reference, built, pixelmatch diff) against Material Design 3 component anatomy and the checked-in reference.

primitives.finding: Groups list with per-group counts and a 'Filter groups' field above it (plain text, regex on request; a match keeps ancestors visible; repaired 2026-09-01). The reference's Cantonese sublabels per group are not built.
Root selection now lists every entry recursively with live add and remove (repaired 2026-09-01); health dots and tag chips per row are still missing against the reference.

Title/Modified/Health segmented control and the Breached/Weak/Reused/Healthy filter chips with live counts; Breached carries no count because breach exposure needs an online check (repaired 2026-09-01).

Hero in the health colour with health chip, edit and history actions, title and mono URL; one rounded container per field with uppercase key, value and copy/reveal actions; Modified row; notes; attachments with the "Filter attachments & fields" search and anchored builder; footer Copy password and Open URL (repaired 2026-09-02).
Search field with regex chip and builder affordance.

deviations.reason: The fixture root group is named 'Passwords' by keepassxc-cli db-create; the reference names it 'Personal'. Data, not chrome.

The reference demo data gives every group a second-language name under its label. Real groups carry one stored name and the vault never invents a translation, so the sublabel line is omitted; counts and indentation match. Entry rows now carry the reference tag chips from each entry’s real tags.
deviations.approval: Reviewed 2026-09-02 against the design-is-data rule: a translated group name would be a fabricated value.
